plantPage.introduction: Our integrated cement manufacturing unit, spread in an area of over 100 hectares, is the most modern, fully automated and energy-efficient plant of its kind in East Africa. The Plant, with a capacity of 1,000,000 Tons per annum, is located at Kimbiji village in Kigamboni District; just 45 km south of Dar es Salaam's central business district.

features.title: 10 MW Captive Power Plant
features.description: Tanzania's first cement plant to have captive power plant, ensuring uninterrupted production with consistent quality and enhanced equipment efficiency.

features.title: Expert Management
features.description: Managed, maintained and operated by a team of qualified cement industry professionals with over 20 years of experience.

features.title: Automated Packing
features.description: Equipped with a fully automated electronic packing machine to maintain a consistently accurate package weight.

features.title: Vertical Roller Mill
features.description: Tanzania's First cement plant with vertical roller mill for higher energy efficiency.

features.title: Clinker Storage
features.description: A closed clinker storage yard for storing 30,000 MT clinker.

features.title: Stacker and Reclaimer
features.description: Equipped with Stacker and Reclaimer for a homogenised feed to the raw mill.
